title: Estimating Marketing Component Effects: Double Machine Learning from Targeted Digital Promotions
authors: Paul B. Ellickson; Wreetabrata Kar; James C. Reeder
eligible_reason: Double machine learning of targeted email promotion effects (orthogonalized scores per treatment-control promotion pair, projected on email components). Randomized promotions, no DiD.
design_notes: FirstStage_ScoreCreation_Replication.r: ranger/glmnet nuisance models and orthogonal scores; SecondStage: lm(Score_rat ~ Characters + Component1-3).
